review.brief: Review the diff of the tier 4 commit. Validate: (1) scope — only kkpa/docs/diagrams/nightly-job/, the Rendered view section of kkpa/context/architecture/nightly-cycle.md, and the change's own files; (2) THE USER'S OWN REQUIREMENT: nightly-cycle-derivation must show the Recalculate inputs, the formula, and the vehicle_metrics attributes derived, consumed and derived consumption included. Open the .json and check; (3) it must draw the CURRENT shape: deriveConsumption takes chargePct, and km_per_pct_calc divides by consumed_pct, NOT by battery_used_pct_calc. A stale diagram here is the exact failure this tier waited on MAG-81 to avoid; (4) all three visual-check JSONs report status pass; (5) the file set mirrors kkpa/docs/diagrams/runtime-architecture/; (6) B2 rule on every label and caption — a label needing a glossary defeats the diagram; (7) no change-doc citation in any caption, label or KB prose; (8) the KB edit states the precedence rule and leaves the stale published-Artifact paragraph alone (that staleness is out of scope, do NOT report it as a finding); (9) tasks.md coverage; (10) no test file — this tier ships no code; (11) anti-gaming. Signals: make archive-guard was assistant-run and clean. NO suite run: this tier ships no Go code, so there was nothing for it to execute — that is the leader's recorded decision, not an omission. Context for you: the first worker was killed by a rate limit mid-tier and left the derivation spec failing validation. A second worker fixed the geometry and re-delivered. Check the final state, not that history.
